purpose: verify the corrected per-channel power-to-RMS implementation on the pinned OAI revision
measure the one-UE AWGN SINR response before revisiting fixed-noise support
preserve a bounded decision gate for the measurement-informed replay study

design.sample_pairing: synchronized RSRP and SINR rows only
design.state_change_rule: attach at -60 dB, command exactly one tested state, settle, collect, restore -60 dB, then recreate the UE
design.independence_limit: execution-level process recreation; not independent RF hardware or environmental repetitions

predeclared_checks.implementation_semantics: source checksum and image identity match the corrected profile; logs report the commanded power-domain dB value
predeclared_checks.noise_monotonicity: median SINR is non-increasing as commanded noise power increases in every complete repetition, allowing ties up to 0.5 dB
predeclared_checks.response_evidence: report execution medians and all pairwise state differences with execution-level bootstrap intervals
predeclared_checks.rsrp_diagnostic: report relative RSRP by state but do not treat it as an absolute calibration target
predeclared_checks.upv_comparison: development sessions only; Test 6 remains untouched

decision_rules.when: all state identities and valid-execution rules pass, and the predeclared SINR monotonicity check passes
source/image identity, applied-value telemetry, or monotonicity fails; stop before replay design
three valid executions cannot be obtained for any state from -60 through -20 dB; retain the failures and do not extrapolate
the corrected control is valid; select no fixed-noise value from this response test alone and freeze a separate gain-replay protocol using development data

stopping_rules: stop before execution if any required revision, patch checksum, image tag, or generated configuration identity differs
stop the current execution on attachment loss, a critical PBCH/PUSCH failure, a UE restart, a gNB restart, unhealthy gNB state, or wrong active channel identity
do not substitute an unplanned noise state after a failed state
do not inspect or score the pre-designated untouched Test 6 session
restore the rollback UE image before releasing the reservation
